text:
Jin Park: Quick pass — what's-new + changelog update is ready in the docs repo. I pushed a draft: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/892. Need final QA on SDK examples (Python + Go), a short migration note for the embedding streaming deprecation, and a sweep for any 404s/anchor rot. Can folks pick tasks?
Marta Gomez: I can take the SDK samples. Will align the Python snippet with the new streaming flag and check the Go example. ETA EOD. :+1:
Kevin Liu: I'll run the site linkcheck and patch redirects. Already seeing 3 broken anchors in the migration guide.
DocsBot: linkcheck job finished — report: https://ci.redwood/linkcheck/54678; results: 3 broken anchors, 1 external 500, 12 warnings.
Lea Ortiz: I wrote the migration note wording but need someone to double-check the compatibility table numbers before we publish.
Samira Khan: I will confirm perf numbers and update the table. Also noticed the Go snippet needs a small import tweak: `import "github.com/redwood/inference/sdk"`.
Priya R.: Suggest adding a small "Known issue" callout about dedupe cache increasing cold-start first-token latency for some models. I have a 2–3 line blurb ready.
Noah: Quick ask — can we avoid changing endpoint examples in the same PR as the migration text? Mixing both caused confusion last release.
Jin Park: Good call. Keep endpoint URL changes separate. Marta/Lea: scope PRs so examples and wording are isolated. Kevin: keep link fixes in a separate PR. Priya: add the known-issue blurb to the release-notes section only. :eyes:
Marta Gomez: Ack. I'll open a follow-up PR if we need endpoint changes after examples parity.
Kevin Liu: Linkfix PR ready for review: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/897 — left notes on the three anchors that need manual redirects and one external fallback.
Samira Khan: Perf numbers confirmed and pushed to the compatibility table. Small rounding note added.
Jin Park: Plan: merge linkfixes by 4pm PT, SDK example parity by 6pm PT, release notes + known issues by 7pm PT. I'll do a final sweep after 7:30pm and then tag the release. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Marta Gomez: Will add short test snippets for the Python streaming flag too — keeping them minimal so they fit the quickstart.
Priya R.: Pushed the known-issue blurb to the release-notes branch; please review wording for tone.
Kevin Liu: Fixed anchors + redirect rules in /_redirects; also added a tiny unit to linkcheck to catch anchor-only changes.
Jin Park: Awesome — if anything blocks, drop a note here or ping me @jin. Otherwise I'll start the merge sequence after 7:30.
